description:
At a banquet, guests playfully present Yuna with a ribbon-adorned chicken plushie after seeing her carrying platters.
"Being cute doesn't excuse everything!"
Yuna's face turns bright red. A special day when her relationship with everyone changed just a little bit.
name: Red-Faced Knight

description:
Established order and granted peace. Such things are merely a cage to imprison me.
That's precisely why I'll destroy it all, with the alchemical power I've learned and accumulated. I wield this power only to satisfy my own desires.
Now, let us begin—the battle for "liberation."
name: Thirst for Liberation

description:
Resna's staff emits a dazzling light.
"Behold! The magnificent power of alchemy!"
She thrusts her staff toward the enemies blocking her path.
Having grown as an alchemist through her journey, she faces the future of alchemy with unwavering determination in her eyes.
name: Light of Alchemy

description:
"Ugh! You guys are so persistent!"
Marlone finds herself surrounded by monsters with no escape route.
But she doesn't panic. After all—
"Time to bring out the big guns! Marlone's Special Mega Flame! Take this!"
She is, after all, the explosive girl who will make her name known throughout the world.
name: The Explosive Girl Marie Arrives!

description:
"Judith! Enemies coming from this way!"
"I know! Hyaaaaaah!!"
Judith travels with Fink the parrot.
"I won't lose here!"
Her adventure, spanning over 200 years, has only just begun.
name: Beyond Distant Time

description:
Happy New Year.
Lately, there have been many unsettling events occurring one after another. I must do my best to ensure everyone can live without worry or anxiety.
May this year bring happiness and wonder to this star.
name: Happiness to This Star

description:
"Done! Look, look, Plachta!"
"Sophie... what are you doing?"
"I found an old recipe in the back of the shelf, so I thought I'd try it..."
"We're in the middle of spring cleaning! Why are you making such a mess!"
name: An Endless Journey

description:
Marlone's alchemical skills have earned her a teaching position at the academy. While she enjoys her fulfilling life as a teacher, her busy days sometimes make her long for a break...
"Maybe I should invite her out to eat sometime..."
The face of her kind friend floats into her mind.
name: Unchanging Friendship

description:
Empel is appointed as Lara's secretary on a trial basis.
"Are you prepared to serve tea at the meeting?"
"Yes, flawlessly. The tea snacks are also ready."
"Excellent, you pass! Now, about signing a contract as an official secretary of the Lara Kingdom..."
"Lady Lara, thank you for having me, brief though it was."
name: Your Excellency, It's Meeting Time

description:
"Firis~"
"Waaah! What is it, Il-chan?"
"Nothing~? Your arm just looked so pinchable right in front of me!"
"Hehe, what's that about? You're weird."
"Ah, no fair! Big sis, let me pinch you too~!"
name: Me Too, Me Too~!

description: New sights, new encounters, thrilling adventures... While such stimulating days are fun, sometimes it's nice to take a break and catch your breath. Reflecting on past events while chatting with companions—that too is part of the journey's flavor.
name: Days Like These Sometimes

description:
—A world of light and darkness, order and chaos, where swords and magic intertwine.
In a corner of such a world lived an alchemist. She knew nothing of the world's rise and fall. Yet, the footsteps she had walked were surely etched in that place.
name: Where She Once Stood

description:
Taking a break in a quiet shade, a cool breeze blows through as flower petals dance in the air. A slightly special moment in an otherwise ordinary day.
It's small but precious happiness. Surely from this will come a magical recipe to make tomorrow even more enjoyable.
name: Magical Recipe

description:
The world is made of various colors. Taking each color in hand, letting the brush run freely across the canvas as the heart desires. Colors overlap and blend, vividly painting stories.
Now then, what shall we create today?
name: A Colored World

description:
Walking through this barren land where dry winds blow, searching for someone precious. Using blooming and scattered flowers as guides, watching the waxing and waning moon, all the way to the distant horizon.
Believing that surely, we'll meet you there.
name: To the Distant Horizon

description: Let's gather a friend or two and set out. Tomorrow surely awaits beyond that door. Let's join hands and sing together. Under the sparkling sky, let's go meet the hopeful morning sun. Forward, forward, down this endless road. We'll surely reach our dreamed future.
name: Toward the Dreamed Future

description:
Closing my eyes, I remember those irreplaceable days. Though I can't see them now, that child, she, he, everyone is by my side, pushing me toward the next world.
I feel like I heard a voice saying "Let's go."
Well then, let me lace up my boots. A new adventure begins—
name: Anytime, Anywhere.

description:
Books are collections of knowledge woven for someone's happiness. My role is to mix this knowledge together to discover recipes for happiness.
Come, tell me your dreams. No matter how impossible they seem, it's okay. I know that if we take it one step at a time, they'll definitely come true.
name: Where Knowledge Gathers

description:
"Hehe. That looks delicious."
"Would you like some, Sophie? In that case..."
Plachta takes a piece of candy and offers it.
"Really? Then without hesitation... say 'aah'"
"Ah! Geez, that tickles..."
A warm sweetness melts in their mouths.
name: In Sweet Cloudiness

description:
"Well then, let's head out today too!"
Ryza always takes my hand and leads me on adventures. Our relationship hasn't changed since we first met. But now, I want to be even closer.
"W-wait, Klaudia?! If you stick so close, it'll be hard to walk..."
name: Closer Than Back Then

description:
When one adventure ends, another awaits. After all, this world is still filled with countless mysteries.
As long as curiosity remains, the adventures will never end.
Now then, onto the next stage—
name: A New Journey Begins

description:
How long has it been since we first met?
Joy, sorrow, happiness, hardship—we've shared it all together.
The time I've spent with you is precious to me.
And I dream of a wonderful future where these moments continue forever—
name: Dreams of Something Special

description:
Adding a secret ingredient to the usual recipe.
Thinking of that person's smiling face, I can't help but smile myself.
Now, let's stir in the finishing touch,
with plenty of love mixed in.
name: A Pinch of Love

description:
Just the two of us beneath the starlit sky.
Adventuring with everyone is fun, but today is different—a special adventure just for us.
It's as if we're the only two people in the world.
May this quiet, warm moment last until dawn—
name: A Special Adventure

description:
A small reward after finishing work.
The sweetness of cake melts away the day's fatigue.
But really, I don't even need the cake.
Just having you beside me makes me so happy that I forget all about being tired.
name: After Work Moments

description:
"Oh? Are you lost? Let Alvie be your guide! Don't worry about payment—it's off the clock! Though if you insist on showing your gratitude—"
"Alvina? Should I report this to the High Priest?"
"J-just kidding, Janne! It was just a joke..."
name: Leave It to Alvie!

description:
Sacred Knight Bepp Zimlock.
Beneath her cold gaze,
her blade moves with bestial ferocity,
hunting, catching, and slaying her prey.
And within each swing lies her conviction—
name: Blade of Conviction

description:
The words we exchanged, the scenery we saw together.
I remember every moment we spent together.
But it's still not enough.
There are words I still want to tell you.
There are sights I still want to see with you.
So please—
name: Stone of Creation

description:
During a break between duties, Janne sits down to rest her weary body. Even the one called the strongest warrior shows a gentler, motherly side when away from the battlefield.
"Oh? Hehe, did you come to see me?"
Her face brightens even more at the sight of someone rushing over.
(That gave me an energy boost♪ I can keep going now!)
name: Holy Knight's Respite

description:
Steadfastly, I've pressed forward to master this path.
It began with inspiration in my youth. And the more I learned, the deeper I delved into this profound and mysterious world.
Even when doubts arise, this power guides me forward. It has until now, and surely will continue to do so.
name: Single-Minded Devotion

description:
The curtain rises on a new adventure.
Filled with both anticipation and anxiety, we look toward the endless sea beyond. What could be waiting for us beyond that horizon?
name: What Awaits Beyond the Sea

description:
I don't know what the right answer is. After all, I don't even know anything about myself.
But I refuse to just accept that and give up. Even if it's just a little at a time, I want to find the answers with my own hands.
Well, thinking isn't really my style... For now, I'll carve my path forward with this sword!
name: With My Own Hands

description:
Alchemy. It was a forbidden art passed down from her mother. What exactly was this power? What were her mother's true intentions?
To learn the truth, Yumia ventures into forbidden territory.
"I want to move forward. After all, I believe every memory is tied to alchemy."
name: To Learn the Truth

description:
He had a difficult and painful past.
Then he encountered the "justice" that saved them.
Viktor moves forward, carrying an unwavering resolve.
"That's why I won't hesitate. On that day, I decided I would follow through with the justice I saw in the chief's back."
name: For the Sake of Justice

description:
From a young age, she believed she couldn't do anything.
That belief became a curse, weighing down her heart and mind.
Lenja's greatest enemy was herself.
"I wanted to prove it. To prove that even I could be useful to someone."
name: The Greatest Enemy

description:
No matter how harsh the investigation gets, never forgetting to stay stylish. It's a principle she refuses to compromise on.
Isla continues to fight, holding her strong convictions close to her heart.
"I've lost enough friends already."
name: Uncompromising Resolve

description:
"That covers the basic tour guide stuff, but...
Now it's time for something special just for Yumia! I'll show you my personal favorite spots!"
"Oh? Well, I guess that would be nice."
"Come on, this way!"
"H-hey... don't pull so hard~"
name: Something Special!

description:
He's overcome every adversity on his own.
Living freely, bound to no one.
That is Rutger's philosophy.
"It's easier to move alone. I get plenty done that way. What's the problem with that?"
name: Walking My Own Path

description:
Sometimes a capable investigator.
Other times, a cheerful and mischievous older sister figure.
She's always composed, yet impossible to pin down.
No one knows Nina's true intentions.
"Fufu, fufufu.... Well then, let's not hold back..."
name: Reliable Skills and...

description:
At the culture festival's live stage, Ryza calls out to the packed crowd while jumping around.
(Wow... Ryza's really popular!)
Suddenly, their eyes meet as Ryza turns around.
With a wink and a nod that says "Let's do this!"
(Alright, I've got to have fun too!)
name: Getting Pumped Up!

description:
After finishing up their work, Heidi and Flocke unwind with a game.
"Heheh, watch my controller skills!"
"Waah, gotta dodge!"
"Look out, I'm gonna pass you, Flocke!"
"W-wait for meee!"
name: The Hot Race Begins!

description:
"This game requires spatial awareness and precise trajectory calculations... in other words, my specialty."
"Amazing! Hey, grab that one next to you too!"
"No. I think we should stop at this machine."
"Eh, why?"
"That too is a calculation."
name: After School Idol

description:
A mechanic's morning doesn't start early.
It seems I dozed off while poring over research papers late into the night. I try to get up slowly... but give up.
"Mmmh... maybe just a little more sleep..."
My mornings start late, end quickly, and are sweet.
name: A Mechanic's Daily Life

description:
Month × Day, Sunny with Occasional Rain
Caught in a sudden downpour on my way home from school, I took shelter under a storefront. A kind person lent me their umbrella. They seemed to be from the militia, but I could have sworn I saw a Lantarna Academy emblem...? Next time I meet them, I must properly thank them!
name: After the Rain

description:
"There's only one Student Council President seat. For everyone who believed in me and entrusted me with their hopes... Roman, I won't lose to you!"
"As someone carrying everyone's dreams, I can't just hand over this honor to you. Let's settle this fair and square!"
name: A Single Honor

description:
I won't run away from any threat. Because there's someone precious I want to protect, no matter what.
"Let's go, Izana."
"Yeah! Knight Izana will show you how well I can protect Resna!"
name: As a Knight

description:
A sweet taste lingers on my tongue. In our private atelier, the sweetness of the candy and the warmth of her shoulder against mine slowly melt together.
We're eating the same thing, so why does hers look so much more appealing?
As my body temperature rises, the sweetness in my mouth seems to intensify.
name: Candy and Body Heat

description:
Resna is a young alchemist who set out on a journey. With a dream of reviving the lost art of alchemy to enrich people's lives, she travels with her companions toward the World's End.
"Alchemy is a magical power that can create something new by combining different things together!"
name: With the Power of Dreams

description:
Valeria, an enigmatic warrior. Having lost her memories of the past, she travels with Resna and the others to discover who she truly is.
"I want to stay by Resna's side, creating things and going on adventures together. That's what I want to do right now."
name: What I Want to Do

description:
Izana, a beast-girl aspiring to become a knight. Carrying her treasured hammer and the promise she made with her best friend Resna in her heart, she continues her journey with her companions today.
"I swear upon the shooting stars! I will become the strongest knight in the future!"
name: Promise with a Friend

description:
Ryza, an adventure-loving alchemist. Free-spirited as ever, she continues her adventures today, following her sense of justice and curiosity.
"Life only happens once, you know? Somehow, I don't like the idea of never realizing what's really important."
name: Adventure and Growth

description:
Sophie, a whimsical alchemist. She can hear the voices of materials and uses alchemy to grant their wishes. Today too, she helps others with her alchemy.
"My dream is the same as Resna's. Let's work together to make people happy with alchemy!"
name: Alchemy of Happiness

description:
Totori, an alchemist raised by the sea. As both an adventurer and experienced sailor, she continues working hard today toward her goal of venturing beyond the Lantarna continent.
"That's why I came to meet you. I want to see what lies beyond the sea too."
name: Beyond the Sea

description:
Rorona, a bright and energetic alchemist. Though she can be a bit clumsy at times, she works hard every day to charm people with her beloved pies.
"Yes! I'll use my pies to cheer everyone up!"
name: Bringing Cheer

description:
Ayesha, a kindhearted alchemist. Gentle and calm by nature, she synthesizes medicine to help those who are suffering. Her remedies not only heal injuries and illnesses but also contain a kindness that soothes troubled hearts.
"I think only we can find what we truly want to do."
name: A Prayer of Comfort

description:
Marie, an energetic and spirited alchemist. Having studied alchemy at an academy, she travels in search of alchemical truth. During her journey, she discovered the various possibilities that alchemy holds.
"I think granting small moments of happiness is also an important role of alchemy."
name: The Role of Alchemy

description:
The girl once called a sparrow has found her wings of freedom. Her gaze is fixed on new lands.
"So this is beyond the continent... Time to let them know about my genius!"
She spreads her wings wide, ready to descend to where her dear friend awaits.
name: Wings to the World

description:
Lila visits an island steeped in Keiun culture. The many trees that have taken root here are said to burst into beautiful pink blossoms when their season comes. But that time hasn't yet arrived.
"I'm sure it must be beautiful. I hope these traditions continue into the future, never to be lost..."
name: A View Yet Unseen

description:
As she gazes at the freshly blooming flowers, Mimi's thoughts are occupied by the girl whose warmth she can feel beside her.
—If the blue flower represents Totori, then perhaps the purple one next to it represents me...
A smile crosses her lips as their hands overlap in response.
name: Your Color

description:
"Miss Rorona! What kind of pie are you making today?"
"Today it's meat pie! Would Totori and Meruru like some?"
"Yay! I love your pies, Rorona!"
"Heheh, I'm so glad. Well then, let's eat while it's still warm!"
name: Rorona's Pie

description:
Tantjn soars high into the sky with Rorona on its back. Perhaps sensing her hunger-induced weakness, the flying Tantjn carries Rorona off somewhere.
"Aaah! Th-This is so high! What if we can't get back down...!"
Only Tantjn knows where they're headed.
name: Higher and Higher

description:
Today is perfect weather for gathering! Totori has brought along her apprentice Meruru for a gathering expedition. The gathering goes smoothly, and before they know it, their baskets are full. Totori calls out to Meruru as she runs across the meadow.
"We'll be gathering all the way back to the atelier, Meruru! Let's synthesize together when we get back!"
name: Perfect Gathering Weather!

description:
"Eek! S-Sterk! What on earth is happening?!"
Sterk scoops up the startled Rorona with one arm as explosions ring out. The sight of the two of them together is like a princess and her knight.
"There's nothing to worry about. Stay close to me. Allow me to protect you as your knight."
name: Princess and Knight

description:
Rorona inherited the atelier by chance. Though she didn't understand anything at first, she ran around frantically every day to continue her daily life with the people important to her. And then—
"I have a place I want to protect."
Her talent as an alchemist bloomed.
name: Blooming Talent

description:
"I have something I must do."
Shallistera gives form to her prayers through alchemy. Her prayer is to save her hometown from the phenomenon known as "Dusk."
"So please, let my wish reach you—!"
Does the light of alchemy illuminate the future she hopes for?
name: Her Mission

description:
Ryza runs across the sandy beach in her swimsuit, ball in hand. Neither the blazing sun overhead nor the glare reflecting off the sand matters to her as she enjoys the moment. If anything, they make her presence shine even brighter.
Her smile as she enjoys her vacation more than anyone else was more dazzling than the sun shining overhead.
name: Dazzling Smile

description: Resna basks in the blazing sunlight. The intense sun that she'd normally struggle with is nothing when she's by the ocean! Wearing a cute ribbon-adorned swimsuit and straw hat, she energetically runs around the beach. What touches her skin—sweat or ocean spray? Resna feels her throat getting dry.
name: Basking in Sunlight

description:
Valeria finishes her swim in the ocean. Her swimming was so powerful and graceful that it didn't seem like she was in water at all, captivating everyone watching.
As she emerges onto land, her wet shirt clings to her body, and droplets trace along her skin. Valeria adjusts the flower ornament in her hair before diving back into the ocean.
name: Soaked by the Waves

description:
Klaudia enjoys her vacation wearing a mature, grown-up swimsuit. The cool ocean temperature against her bare skin feels wonderful on her sun-warmed body.
In her line of sight is her best friend running across the beach with a ball. Klaudia brushes back her wave-dampened hair to respond to her friend's call.
name: Sun-Kissed Body

description:
Antje bites into the watermelon that Janne cut for her. The sweetness and juiciness cause her cheeks to relax with pleasure.
"Hehe, you eat it so deliciously. Hey, why don't you try cutting the watermelon next, Antje?"
"Eh... I-I'll give it a try..."
"Yes! I'll teach you the secret to cutting watermelon perfectly."
name: The Secret to Cutting Watermelon

description:
"Let's go! Criselda!"
"Yes! Full speed ahead!"
Antje's boat races across the course at incredible speed. Antje didn't want to lose. She wanted to make this time with her precious friend into the best memory possible.
"I absolutely won't lose...! Full speed ahead!"
name: Full Speed Ahead!

description:
Shallotte, Miruca, and Shallistera race across the water on flying boards.
"Amazing...! This is the ocean!"
"It's so vast! Super huge! All right, let's go as far as we can!"
The ocean stretches endlessly in all directions.
name: Heading for the Horizon

description:
"Wow, it looks great on you! So cute! Valeria, try this one on next!"
"It's cute, but... I feel a bit self-conscious. Can't I just wear my usual outfit?"
"Oh, come on! We went shopping specially for this, so let's dress up and have fun!"
name: Let's Get Fashionable!

description:
Lara bursts energetically from the water's surface. Though soaked and her usual curls disheveled, her charming smile undoubtedly belongs to the queen of the "Lara Kingdom."
"Come now, don't just stand there. Join me, your queen, in enjoying this moment."
name: The Charming Queen

description:
Sophie splashes around in the crystal-clear ocean with her friends. Joyful voices echo all around.
Sudenly, when their eyes meet, the sun peeks out from behind the large cloud towering behind her.
The sun, or her smile? The brightness dazzles the eyes.
name: Thanks to the Sun

description:
Yumia comes to the beach with her fellow Aladiss Research Team members. Her teammates compliment how well her swimsuit suits her, and she shows a proud smile.
Even in her swimsuit, she doesn't remove the red bandana that serves as proof of her membership in the research team. Now then, let's call it a beachside investigation.
name: Beachside Investigator

description: Marie came to play in the water with her best friend Shia. Diving into the water on impulse, she sees a blue world sparkling with streaming sunlight. She wants to share the beautiful scenery she witnessed with her precious friend. Marie surfaces and takes Shia's hand, diving back into the blue world once more.
name: The Blue World I Want to Show You

description:
In Shallotte's hometown of Stellard, there's a traditional event called the "Water Festival."
Even during times of water shortage, people bathe in water to express their gratitude. For Shallotte and Shallistera, the day they participated together is a precious memory.
With gratitude for precious water, they'll continue living into the future.
name: A Water Festival from Long Ago

description:
"Oh no, that's not Alvina... Eek!"
Due to an unfortunate mishap, part of Criselda's swimsuit came undone. Even she, who always maintains her composure, can't hide her fluster at this moment, her cheeks flushed red.
"So Criselda is human after all!"
"Hehe, you caught me at an embarrassing moment."
name: When Composure Crumbles

description:
"The race I'm hosting is officially beginning!"
"I'm going to fly! Don't fall behind!"
Carried by momentum, Johanna's boat soars across the water. Johanna didn't want to lose. Before proving her genius, she wanted to enjoy this moment to the fullest.
"I absolutely won't lose! Just watch me!"
name: I Won't Lose!
